result_text:
Confirmed: each package runs plain `tsc --noEmit` against source (with `@/*` path aliases pointing straight into `web-core/src`), so errors in web-core files propagate into any package that imports them.

**Summary:** The only call sites of `makeLocalApiRequest` (all currently 2-arg calls) live in `api.ts`, `useWorkspaces.ts`, and `useRelayWorkspaceHostHealth.ts`. `web-core` owns two of these files directly. `local-web` transitively type-checks `api.ts` (via `Bootstrap.tsx`, `ConfigProvider.tsx`) and `useWorkspaces.ts` through the same path since its `@/*` alias points at `web-core/src`. `remote-web` transitively type-checks `api.ts` (via many pages/providers) and owns `useRelayWorkspaceHostHealth.ts` directly. `ui` has no references to `localApiTransport` and is unaffected.

```json
{"files": ["packages/web-core/src/shared/lib/api.ts", "packages/web-core/src/shared/hooks/useWorkspaces.ts", "packages/remote-web/src/shared/hooks/useRelayWorkspaceHostHealth.ts"], "packages": ["@vibe/web-core", "@vibe/local-web", "@vibe/remote-web"]}
```
